docs.text: POV very early morning where our Easterly plant meets Lake Erie.
Spent today’s beautiful morning by Lake Erie 😌
Good gorgeous Tuesday morning. The first Great Lakes cruise ship of the year is anchored off Point Pelee. What a peaceful place for them to wake 😊 The Hooman has been walked 🐾 Coffee, SVP ☕️☕️☕️
🍃🌹Good morning. Thank you, Kip. It’s beautiful on the shore of Lake Erie. Know you enjoyed your trip! Happy, blessed Sunday & coming new week.Take care.🌹🙏🏻🥰👋☕️🌹🍃
Good morning from the Lake County section of Lake Erie!
A perfect morning here on the north shore of Lake Erie.
Good morning 😊☕️ It’s a muggy 72F on the shore of Lake Erie. Have a great day 😊
Hi Aleesia👋😃, and thank you so much. Happy Wednesday! Lake Erie offers some beautiful sunsets. Have a great day!

Good Morning 😊
Heading to the Lake Erie Islands today! Have a great day!

Good evening Irma. 👋 It was a productive day here on Ohio’s ‘North Coast’ near Lake Erie. Enjoyed a 70’ F day with sunshine. But I will admit after Springing ahead, I miss that hour. 😀 Fixed that with a snooze with a cat. Wishing you and the peeps here a peaceful evening and restful slumbers.
